scope: Phase 5 local runtime verification against a uniquely owned disposable PostgreSQL 17/pgvector container. No production or hosted database, object storage, CDN, environment setting, or deployment was inspected or changed.
working_tree_revision: Repository HEAD plus uncommitted Phase 3-5 working-tree changes; see git status at handoff.

runtime_evidence.fixture: scripts/run-supabase-integration.ts created an ephemeral PostgreSQL 17/pgvector container bound to loopback with tmpfs data, a memory limit, isolated child environment, and ownership-checked cleanup.

verified_behaviors: All repository migrations applied in lexical order; the targeted image request, private human Work/Star publishing, and allowance migrations were safely replayed for idempotency checks.
Owner-private Works remained visible only through the owner-scoped library path; anon and authenticated owner/non-owner checks did not expose another human's Work.
Human writes and transitions into Star-published/public state were rejected; the internal authorized Star path published a Work visible in the public feed and Star archive.
Public feed/archive projections excluded private human Works; role grants, RLS, forced RLS, and projection predicates were checked against PostgreSQL catalogs and role execution.
Unapproved allowance configuration failed closed; reservations were atomic under concurrent idempotent and competing requests, with insufficient quota rejected before dispatch.

Successful, known pre-dispatch rejection/cancellation, expiration, and ambiguous/unknown lifecycle outcomes preserved their specified reserved/settled/released accounting; replayed cleanup and worker calls did not double-transition or dispatch.

Browser roles had no direct private-table access or write grants on public projections; denied-role probes used savepoints so one expected SQL error did not contaminate later assertions in the same transaction.
defects_found_and_fixed: Removed the historical four-argument fn_batch_mutate_image_library overload; its coexistence with a defaulted five-argument version made ordinary four-argument repository calls ambiguous.

Changed the image-request generation trigger to bootstrap a missing human identity only; PostgreSQL fires a BEFORE INSERT identity trigger even for an ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING attempt, which previously conflicted with immutable autonomous Star classification.

Corrected the grant assertion so its public projection write check excludes SELECT, and isolated expected-denial probes with savepoints. These were integration-harness defects, not permission-policy relaxations.

remaining_gates.documentation checks: FAIL at that run because scripts/test-image-requests-db.ts changed after its semantic review; a focused review refresh and certification rerun are required.
remaining_gates.compiled boundary scan: FAIL at that run for the same stale source-review fingerprint; the emitted scan did inspect 526 assets without reporting private markers/runtime trace paths.
remaining_gates.hosted deployment audit: BLOCKED; no explicit read-only production database target was selected, and object-storage/CDN inventories and deployed environment/route evidence remain absent.
remaining_gates.allowance configuration: UNAPPROVED; no plan allowance or output cost/weight values were invented.

limits: Disposable PostgreSQL runtime behavior is verified only for the repository fixture; it is not proof that hosted Supabase has the same migrations, grants, policies, views, or settings.
Historical public object URLs, bucket visibility, CDN caches, deployed authentication, and production route authorization remain unverified.
No image provider request, paid creation, production write, migration deployment, cache purge, or allowance activation occurred.
